Tessonics Resistance Spot Weld Analyzer: Tessonics Resistance Spot Weld Analyzer (RSWA). RSWA is an ultrasonic device for quality control and NDE (non-destructive evaluation) of resistance spot welds. This portable, easy-to-operate device images the internal structure of a spot weld; in addition to the live on-screen image, RSWA estimates the nugget diameter and compares it with a predefined minimum nugget size. Using multi-channel ultrasonic matrix transducer technology, RSWA collects data from the surface and internal structure of the nugget. Dedicated algorithms process this data to reconstruct the spot weld image and estimate the average nugget diameter in real time. Features: Single-frame and continuous data acquisition modes. Automatic and manual nugget size estimation. Automatic detection of scan depth within the metal. Two levels of interface complexity to suit operator expertise.
